meta.produced_by: readiness sweep, measurement-only (no ingest, no writes)
meta.method: HTTP range request bytes=0-0 with full browser UA against the StratMap per-county URL template. Projection measured on 27 counties: 4 by full archive download + DBF/PRJ/SHP-header read, 23 by partial-zip range fetch of the .prj and .shp header.
meta.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/124.0 Safari/537.36
meta.projection_finding: The 202505 vintage ships PROJCS["WGS_1984_Web_Mercator_Auxiliary_Sphere"] with coordinates in METERS. 12 of 12 sampled 202505 counties are projected; 15 of 15 sampled counties on 202503/202507/202508/202509 are geographic degrees. The ingest WGS84 guard is a substring test for GCS_WGS_1984, which the Web Mercator PRJ also contains as a nested GEOGCS, so the guard PASSES on all of them and meter coordinates would load silently.
meta.projection_caveat: projection_inferred_from_vintage is INFERENCE for the 227 counties not directly sampled. The vintage-to-projection correlation is perfect across 27 samples but is not proof for every county; verify each .prj at ingest time via a coordinate-range assertion rather than trusting this field.
